name: phase2_infrastructure_failures
description: Phase 2 cutover: one count per request a Phase 2 financial callable lost to a timeout (HTTP 504 in the request log) or per untyped failure whose stack names DEADLINE_EXCEEDED, UNAVAILABLE or RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED. Counts only; extracts nothing from the log entry. Read by phase2-infrastructure-repeated.policy.json.
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.location="australia-southeast1" AND resource.labels.service_name=("createvariation" OR "updatevariationdraft" OR "approvevariation" OR "applyvariationcommitment" OR "progressclaimoperation" OR "supplierinvoiceoperation" OR "suppliersettlementoperation" OR "postclientrefund" OR "voidclientrefund" OR "postclientreceiptapplication" OR "voidclientreceiptapplication" OR "voidclientinvoice" OR "contractvalueoperation" OR "estimateoperation" OR "postclientcreditnote" OR "voidclientcreditnote" OR "postclientretentionrelease" OR "voidclientretentionrelease" OR "postclientreceipt" OR "voidclientreceipt" OR "transferboqtobudget" OR "approvefinalaccount") AND ((log_id("run.googleapis.com/requests") AND httpRequest.status=504) OR (log_id("run.googleapis.com/stderr") AND severity>=ERROR AND jsonPayload.message:"call failed" AND (jsonPayload.stack:"DEADLINE_EXCEEDED" OR jsonPayload.stack:"UNAVAILABLE" OR jsonPayload.stack:"RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED")))
